glyph.isekai_mahou.converge.desc: Two orbs, in the colors of the 1st and 2nd effects, spin in front of you and fuse in 1 s into a huge, slow sphere that passes through blocks and creatures in a straight line (40–64 blocks), applying the effects to everything it touches with +25% power and erasing a TUNNEL of terrain as wide as the sphere along the way (if destruction is on). With Pull and Push together the forces cancel out and targets are dragged along by the sphere. Expand makes the sphere (and the tunnel) bigger; Split fans out spheres.
glyph.isekai_mahou.annihilate.desc: Erases a piece of the target from existence: damage equal to 12% of max health (up to 30) + 6 that ignores armor, and the body crumbles to dust. On a block, erases a sphere of terrain without drops (radius ~2, grows with area and power up to 7) if destruction is on.
glyph.isekai_mahou.sky_lances.desc: Three magic lenses (+1 per Split) appear in the sky above the targeted area (up to 48 blocks away). For 3 s, on every pulse, they fire beams of light at EVERY target in the area (55% power per beam). A roof protects from the beam. With destruction on, each beam melts the ground into glass and the final flash vitrifies the whole area. Expand increases the area; Extend, the time.
glyph.isekai_mahou.spiral_sphere.desc: A spinning sphere of energy held in your hand for up to 4 s. Touch or strike an enemy: it grabs and grinds them with several quick hits (30% power each), then bursts into wind, applying the spell at full power and hurling them away (bosses are not held and fly less far). After a link, it is launched forward instead.
glyph.isekai_mahou.slash_storm.desc: 6 to 10 invisible cuts in 1 s on the target and anyone right next to it (1.5 damage each, no knockback), streaking the air white and marking the blocks around — with destruction on, half of the cuts carve straight grooves into the terrain. In a Domain it becomes a continuous storm that shreds the ground.
legend.isekai_mahou.hollow_purple.desc: Attraction (blue) and repulsion (red) spin, fuse and release a purple sphere that annihilates everything in a straight line, even the terrain.
legend.isekai_mahou.crimson_ruin.desc: A slow, homing orb of black flame that annihilates whatever it touches, ignoring armor.
legend.isekai_mahou.malevolent_shrine.de: A domain without walls: every enemy inside is shredded by endless invisible slashes, and the ground is scarred.
legend.isekai_mahou.solar_megiddo.desc: Lenses in the sky focus sunlight into beams that strike every enemy in the area, again and again.
legend.isekai_mahou.spiral_sphere.desc: A sphere of wind spinning in your hand: touch an enemy to grind them and hurl them away.
legend.isekai_mahou.killing_ray.desc: The "ordinary" offensive beam: fast, cheap and pierces several enemies in a line.
legend.isekai_mahou.holy_law.desc: A huge cataclysm of light that judges only enemies: holy rays fall on all of them.
message.isekai_mahou.legends_b.spiral_re: Spiral Sphere ready! Touch or strike an enemy.
